name: Quick Pill 5.5.1
changelog: Quick App Launcher 1.5x Enlargement: Expanded window size (885x278) for high-efficiency application switching, larger workspace profile editor, and instant catalog search.
Settings & Tab Navigation: Smooth vertical scrolling in sidebar categories, wheel swipe protection, and customizable Alt-based tab shortcuts.

Quick Notes & Contextual Capture: Instant note capture with debounced autosave and crash recovery, searchable notes inbox with tags and filters, contextual clipboard capture with large-content guard, and non-destructive note-to-task conversion.

Smart Notification Actions: Intelligent notification interaction layer with WhatsApp/VoIP call cards, inline replies, local snooze presets (5m, 15m, 30m, 1h), grouped multi-message stacks, low-priority collapsing, privacy preview masking, and dismissal undo buffer.

Universal Progress Island: Centralized background progress tracking interface anchored at the top-center Dynamic Island, supporting file copy/hash operations, background auto-updater progress, and cancellable task workflows.
Per-App Audio Mixer: Native Windows Core Audio WASAPI mixer to adjust individual application volume levels, mute/unmute audio streams, monitor peak volume meters, and toggle audio output devices.
Apple Dynamic Island Battery Hub: Redesigned with Apple HIG design, 60 FPS right-to-left fluid liquid wave canvas physics engine, buoyant micro-bubbles, and real-time battery duration forecasting.
Persistent Always-On-Top & Background Timers: Screen-saver topmost priority level, wall-clock synchronized timers that never pause on lock screen or sleep.
Silent Background Auto-Updater: When a new release is detected, the app automatically downloads and silently installs the update via NSIS in the background, with user preferences in Settings.

Customizable Instant Tab Shortcuts: System-wide and in-app instant Alt+key shortcuts to open all 16 tabs instantly without conflicting with the Click-Through feature, fully customizable with collision handling in the Settings tab.
